name: Eurostat migr_resocc
provides: First permits for remunerated activity by permit category x citizenship x member state x year
notes: The dependent variable. Suppressed cells arrive as null and are dropped rather than zero-filled.

name: Eurostat migr_resfirst
provides: All-reason first permits (employment/family/education/other)
notes: Context and denominators.

name: Eurostat migr_pop1ctz
provides: Resident population by citizenship - the bilateral diaspora variable
notes: Used in place of UN DESA Migrant Stock 2020 which returns HTTP 403 to programmatic clients.

name: Eurostat jvs_a_rate_r2
provides: Job vacancy rate total and by NACE sector
notes: No s_adj dimension on this dataset.

name: Eurostat nama_10_a10 / nama_10_a10_e
provides: Compensation of employees and employment by sector - sector pay
notes: Compensation in EUR million divided by employment in thousands.

name: Eurostat une_rt_a
provides: Unemployment rate

name: Eurostat demo_pjanind
provides: Old-age dependency ratio
notes: Structural demand proxy.

name: World Bank World Development Indicators
provides: Income, unemployment, education, demography, urbanisation, internet, remittances
notes: Latest non-null observation per country within the window.

name: World Bank Worldwide Governance Indicators
provides: Corruption, government effectiveness, political stability, rule of law, regulatory quality, voice
notes: Codes are GOV_WGI_*.EST; a country/all query returns empty ISO3 codes so the country list is named explicitly and batched.

name: CEPII GeoDist
provides: Distance, contiguity, shared official and ethnic language, colonial relationship, common coloniser
notes: Ships as .xls inside the zip. Uses 2011-vintage codes (ZAR/ROM) and predates South Sudan; aliased and haversine-filled respectively.

name: OpenFlights
provides: Direct airline route counts between country pairs
notes: Community-maintained and not fully current; used only as a relative connectivity proxy.

name: Wikidata
provides: Diplomatic missions by operating state and host state
notes: Embassy coverage is good and cross-checks against known posting counts (France 49 African embassies). Consulate coverage is thinner and is fetched as an optional supplement.

name: CIA World Factbook
provides: Religious composition and official languages
notes: Free text parsed to shares. Reported granularity is uneven so the religion vector is deliberately coarse. Raw source string retained on every row.

name: ISO 3166 with UN M49 codes
provides: ISO2/ISO3/M49, UN region and intermediate region
notes: The join spine.

name: Curated agreements register
provides: Bilateral labour agreements, EU Talent and Mobility Partnerships, CPLP mobility, Decreto Flussi preferential quotas
notes: NEEDS EXPERT REVIEW BEFORE CITATION. Every row carries a source URL and its own confidence flag.

name: ICMPD/ECDPM master pathway files
provides: Policy attributes, sector tags and origin eligibility for 354 EU legal pathways
notes: Referenced by the concept note but not publicly available. The largest fidelity gap; ease-of-unlocking is built from public substitutes instead.

name: DG HOME Schengen visa statistics
provides: Short-stay visa applications and refusals by Schengen state and country of application; also the authoritative list of where visa applications can be lodged
notes: Short-stay (Schengen C) not work permits - a friction proxy. Ireland is outside Schengen and Cyprus reports separately; both fall back to Wikidata.

name: World Bank Poverty and Inequality Platform
provides: Median daily welfare in 2021 PPP; the basis for the income-gain measure
notes: Reports consumption for most African countries and income for most European ones - the welfare_type column is carried through so the mismatch stays visible.

name: WHO health workforce support and safeguards list
provides: Countries where active international recruitment of health personnel is discouraged
notes: 55 countries, 40 of them among our origins. Flag only - never enters a score. The 2026 update was still unpublished as of Aug 2026; the May 2026 Global Code amendment extended the Code to care workers but did not reissue the list.

name: world.geo.json country outlines
provides: Country polygons for the map
notes: Five small island states (Cabo Verde, Comoros, Mauritius, Sao Tome, Seychelles) are absent from the source and are drawn as capital markers instead.

name: ICMPD/ECDPM/MPF Labour Pathways mapping
provides: Roster of legal labour migration pathways across the EU-27; title, description, link
vintage: fieldwork to Feb 2024; records modified late 2024
notes: API returns 295 pathways (MPF note says 294; the concept note's 354 is unverified anywhere public). Structured attributes (country, sector, quota, salary, language, labour market test) are Pods fields not exposed to REST, and /pods/v1 is 401. The country-to-pathway join is NOT recoverable - ID-order grouping was tested both ways against slug fingerprints and fails. No country assigned. Policy signals parsed from description text are derived, not ICMPD fields.

name: UNHCR Refugee Data Finder
provides: Bilateral refugee and asylum-seeker stocks
notes: Needs coo_all/coa_all flags; plain coo=/coa= filters return an empty item list rather than an error. 414 Africa-EU pairs carry stock.

name: UCDP battle-related deaths via World Bank
provides: Conflict intensity at origin
notes: The concept note names UCDP/PRIO directly; that API now requires an access token, so the World Bank's republication of the same UCDP series is used. Origin coverage 52%.

name: Hofstede six-dimension cultural scores
provides: Cultural distance (Kogut-Singh)
notes: 14 African countries surveyed individually; Hofstede's own Africa East / Africa West / Arab clusters used where they plausibly apply; Middle Africa and most of Southern Africa left unavailable.

name: UNESCO Institute for Statistics
provides: Tertiary graduates by ISCED field of study (health & welfare, ICT, engineering, agriculture, services, business, STEM) and share of 15-24s in vocational education
notes: Field-of-study data for 44 of 54 origins. Shares of all graduates, not headcounts; combine with population for scale. The ISCED fields map onto the tool's occupation families, which is what lets the sector overlay use origin supply.

name: WHO Global Health Observatory
provides: Health workforce density: nurses and midwives, and doctors, per 10,000 population
notes: Complete for all 81 countries. Origin median 11.7 per 10k against 82.6 in destinations. The one occupation with a direct headcount on both sides.

name: Curated destination requirements register
provides: EU Blue Card and general permit salary thresholds, language requirements, qualification recognition regimes and key route requirements for all 27 destinations
notes: NEEDS EXPERT REVIEW. Thresholds move annually by statute. Explicit numeric thresholds are on file for a minority of states; the rest carry a described basis. Every row has a source URL and its own confidence flag.

name: Curated outsourced visa centre register
provides: VFS Global, TLScontact and BLS International centres processing applications for each destination in each origin country
notes: 129 corridors. NEEDS VERIFICATION - operator networks change frequently. Scored below an in-country mission but well above having to cross a border.

name: Eurostat migr_resfirst (education reason)
provides: Bilateral first residence permits issued for study
notes: Already downloaded for context and previously unused. 127,622/yr Africa-EU student permits against 118,010 work permits - students are the larger flow.
